messages:
Lina (Content): quick sync / microcopy sprint for tri-mode pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need: 1-line hero per mode, short subhead, 2 social captions, webinar hook + 3 takeaways, and exact form->queue routing. Ship variants to staging by COB.

Omar (Growth): Ill own the socials + UTMs. Plan: announce + reminder 48h. Test angle: 'lower unit costs' vs 'predictable tails'.

Priya - PMM: Ill do subheads and webinar bullets. Keep benefits buyer-focused (time-to-production, predictable billing, security posture). No hard numbers.

Dylan (Ops): routing rules draft below. Detect company email domain + enterprise keywords. Add utm_campaign and event_id.

```
form_type -> queue (conditions)
contact:demo -> sales-enterprise (company_email OR company_size>250)
signup:trial -> growth-trials (company_email)
signup:self-serve -> onboarding-self-serve (personal_email)
question:compliance -> solutions-eng (compliance:true)
support:incident -> eng-oncall (severity:high)
```

Lina (Content): hero lines (short, pick one per mode):
- Hosted: "Build fast with production inference."
- Hosted (alt): "Instant API access for LLM features."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPUs for steady high-throughput."
- Dedicated (alt): "Committed capacity, consistent performance."
- Private: "Keep inference inside your network."
- Private (alt): "On-prem & VPC for regulated workloads."

Priya - PMM: subheads (one sentence each):
- Hosted: "Start shipping features without managing infra."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput and SLA-backed uptime."
- Private: "Full control over data locality and access."

Priya - PMM: webinar headline + bullets:
Headline: "Serving LLMs: Practical Benchmarks, Choices, and Runbooks"
Bullets:
- "What matters: median latency, tail latency, and unit cost"
- "Which mode fits your product and risk profile"
- "Operational runbook: rollout steps, fallbacks, and monitoring"

Omar (Growth): social caption drafts:
- Announce (cost focus): "Lower inference spend while keeping answer quality. See Hosted, Dedicated, and Private options + benchmarks. Webinar + demo -> [link]?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=tri-mode"
- Announce (reliability focus): "Dependable LLM features with predictable latency and clear controls. Join our demo to compare deployment modes -> [link]?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=tri-mode"

Dylan (Ops): ops notes: add field company_size and compliance_checkbox to the form. If company_size>1000 or enterprise_key present, set priority=high and include enterprise_sdr in CC. Tag all webinar signups with event_id and utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch.

WebhookBot: Reminder: staging deploy scheduled at 17:45 PT once assets are uploaded to /marketing/staging.

Lina (Content): assigning: Omar finalizes socials + UTMs; Priya tightens webinar bullets with takeaways; Dylan wires forms->CRM routing; Ill compile and upload copy to staging for signoff. Back in 90 minutes for quick review. :white_check_mark:
